data.text: Luke, you’ve just joined us, and I’d rather welcome you as a long-term neighbor than watch us lose the lake together. A full haul pays once; a healthy lake keeps supporting our families. I’m willing to take 10 tons, but reviewing catches afterward won’t save the stock if it’s already gone. Can we all agree before fishing to a shared 50-ton ceiling, split equally, and check our catches together as we land them? Luke, would you accept that arrangement—and if not, what concern would we need to address?
